name: room-probes-simple
description: R7-L ladder, SIMPLE rung. Per-room specular probes (`roomProbes`) open, render and are correctly flag/tier-gated. Each claim is asserted from TWO independent call sites — the resolved flag in the store AND the live scene graph (how many materials carry `userData.roomProbeRecord`, and how many DISTINCT probe centres they hold) — because a flag that is on while nothing is patched, or while every material shares one centre, is a global probe wearing a per-room name. The COMPLEMENT is asserted in both directions: the kill switch must fully detach AND turning it back on must re-attach, and `performance` must carry none (no baked GI for the probe to complete and, on the weak variant, no `scene.environment` to patch at all). Boots straight into `realistic` rather than switching tier mid-session — a runtime promotion rebuilds the material cache underneath the attach, which is a separate hazard and not what this rung is for (see the demote-only check at the end).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: assert-simple-mode-flag
steps.failMessage: roomProbes is a simple-tier fidelity flag and must be ON in Simple mode — a default-look change must not sit behind a pro flag (meta-rule xiii)

steps.name: assert-pro-mode-flag
steps.failMessage: roomProbes should be ON in Pro mode too

steps.name: assert-present-on-realistic
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; const centres = new Set(); window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; const r = m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord; if (r) { n++; centres.add(r.uniforms.center.value.toArray().join(',')) } }); console.log('[probe] realistic: ' + n + ' materials across ' + centres.size + ' probe centres'); if (n === 0) throw new Error('realistic tier carries NO room probes — the feature is inert'); if (centres.size < 2) throw new Error('every material shares one probe centre (' + centres.size + ') — this is a GLOBAL probe wearing a per-room name') })()

steps.name: assert-vram-budget
steps.eval: (() => { const rooms = new Set(); window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; const r = m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord; if (r) rooms.add(r.roomId) }); const cap = 6; if (rooms.has('corridor')) throw new Error('the CORRIDOR holds a probe: that is the R7-Z binning artefact back (an InstancedMesh bounded by the union of its instances lands in the middle of the plan) - it scores 0.18 on the default flat when binned per instance'); console.log('[probe] ' + rooms.size + ' probe rooms: ' + [...rooms].sort().join(', ') + ' = ' + (rooms.size * 6).toFixed(1) + ' MB at a 256 cube'); if (rooms.size > cap) throw new Error('room-probe VRAM budget blown: ' + rooms.size + ' probes against the' + ' realistic/capable cap of ' + cap + ' (quality.ts roomProbeMaxRooms, ~6 MB each at a 256 cube = 36.0 MB)'); if (!rooms.has('bath2')) throw new Error('bath2 has no probe — it ranks SIXTH after R7-Z (bedroom2 1.87 > bath2 1.84), so any cap below 6 silently drops it back' + ' to reflecting the global studio while bath1 reflects itself') })()

steps.name: assert-boxes-are-real-rooms
steps.eval: (() => { let checked = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; const r = m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord; if (!r || checked >= 40) return; checked++; const lo = r.uniforms.boxMin.value, hi = r.uniforms.boxMax.value, c = r.uniforms.center.value; const w = hi.x - lo.x, d = hi.z - lo.z, h = hi.y - lo.y; if (!(w > 0.5 && w < 12) || !(d > 0.5 && d < 12)) throw new Error('probe box is not a room: ' + w.toFixed(2) + ' x ' + d.toFixed(2)); if (!(h > 1.5 && h < 4)) throw new Error('probe box height is not a storey: ' + h.toFixed(2)); if (Math.abs(c.x - (lo.x + hi.x) / 2) > 1e-3) throw new Error('probe centre is not the box centre, which the projection assumes') }); if (checked === 0) throw new Error('no probe boxes to check') })()

steps.name: assert-detached
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; if (m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord) n++ }); if (n !== 0) throw new Error('the kill switch left ' + n + ' materials patched — a gate that only works in one direction is not a gate') })()

steps.name: assert-reattached
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; if (m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord) n++ }); console.log('[probe] re-attached ' + n + ' materials'); if (n === 0) throw new Error('the kill switch is one-way: turning roomProbes back on re-attached nothing') })()

steps.name: assert-absent-on-performance
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; if (m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord) n++ }); if (n !== 0) throw new Error('performance tier must carry NO room probes, found ' + n) })()
